labeled_draw: Dataset order from 33-17 CLASSIC, SeedSequence(20261026).spawn(5), uniform frame permutation without replacement; nested prefixes of 5, 10, 20.

bootstrap.frame_cluster: physical BOP scene_id; resample the same number of scenes and retain every included frame of a sampled scene, with multiplicity
bootstrap.R6_across_datasets: show full five-dataset image CI and the image CI on the same eligible dataset set as the scene CI

ranking.tie: Reuse 33-17 detector score, source, then rank
ranking.multiplication: A10 = raw detector score times archived depth consistency, archived A10 AR used
ranking.nonfinite: No valid raw FP score means no valid A-series candidate

calibration.label: Minimum same-object symmetry-aware MSSD < 0.1 D_o (frozen 33-17 E-D)
calibration.predictor: s_raw standardized by labeled rows separately within each fit
calibration.fit: Logistic maximum penalized likelihood with L2 penalty 0.5*standardized_slope^2 and no intercept penalty; no sign constraint. Report slopes on original raw scale.
calibration.missing_class: For evaluation only, if one class absent in a source fit use the Laplace-smoothed source prevalence (positive+1)/(n+2), report fallback. Learnability records an unfit draw and treats it as not establishing a negative sign; also report proportions among fit draws.
calibration.zero_variance: Unpenalized intercept with constant slope zero
calibration.heldout_pair_accuracy: The k-specific heldout sets are used for all evaluated rows, and report full-gallery anchors separately.

learnability.draw: Uniform nested frame prefixes, shared between sources; independent spawned seeds across datasets

E2.pair_scope: All positive-negative within-target pairs in the full gallery
E2.priority: a if any other-object GT visible mask has IoU >= 0.5, otherwise b if same-object GT mask reaches 0.5, otherwise c; separately report overlaps with both types
E2.reversed_pairs: Correct score strictly below incorrect score; ties are separate

covariates.valid_depth: fraction of mask pixels with observed depth > 0
covariates.render_iou: CPU BOP cpp/OpenGL software rasterization of the original registration CAD mesh with the archived winning pose and full-image camera intrinsics; IoU with the actual detector mask
covariates.correct_visibility: Visibility of the lowest-MSSD same-object GT among MSSD-correct instances, tie by GT id
covariates.b_visibility: Visibility of maximum-IoU same-object visible mask, tie by GT id

E3.AP: Reweight detections and GT by frame multiplicities within the archived official BOP24 matches, recompute interpolated AP per category and average MSSD/MSPD, preserving 33-17 convention.
E3.R6: Report directional exclusion of zero separately for every requested comparison and eligible scope.

reading.R1: Full-gallery five-dataset A1neg-A4: CI inside [-1,1] equal, upper strictly below -1 lower, lower strictly above 1 higher, otherwise uncertain.
reading.R2: Full-gallery five-dataset A1neg-A10 CI lower strictly above zero.
reading.R3: Heldout k=10 A1cal10-A4; same equivalence boundaries as R1.
reading.R4: Each dataset × source at k=10 has at least 95% negative slopes across all 1000 draws.
reading.R5: Pooled b-a and b-c differences in strict raw-score pair accuracy have paired image-bootstrap CI lower strictly above zero for both; report category prevalence separately.
reading.R6: For each comparison whose image interval excludes zero, report whether the scene interval still excludes zero in the same direction.
